The '''BR1-Z''' was a model of [[blast-rifle]] manufactured by [[Core World Arms]]. Each rifle cost 1,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], had an ammo capacity of fifty shots and a range of 150 [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="TotJC" />
